row: Hey guys! My name is Veronica and I'm a 28-year-old mom and wife. I started vet school in fall of 2022 at UGA and am on track to graduate May of 2026!! There will be videos on lifestyle, veterinary medicine, and sometimes vlogs. Videos will be posted every other week so be sure to like and subscribe!
